title: Healthcare AI Platform
tagline: End-to-end AI platform for community healthcare and clinical automation
description: End-to-end healthcare AI platform combining Medical LLMs, LangGraph workflows, React Native applications, FastAPI microservices, and Bluetooth-enabled medical device integrations. Designed to streamline community healthcare through patient triage, AI-assisted clinical documentation, intelligent reception, and proactive follow-up workflows.
markdown:
Healthcare AI Automation Suite is a production healthcare platform built to support teleconsultation workflows through AI-driven clinical assistance, backend services, and mobile device integration. I led the engineering of most of the platform's core components, taking features from architecture and implementation through deployment, testing, and continuous production improvements.

The platform includes intelligent patient triage, AI-assisted clinical documentation, encounter summarization, follow-up automation, clinical decision support, document understanding, and conversational healthcare workflows. I engineered reliable AI pipelines that combined structured validation, Medical LLMs, and deterministic safety mechanisms to generate consistent, structured outputs suitable for clinical environments.

Beyond the AI systems, I designed and developed scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI, building modular APIs, shared data models, authentication, request validation, and integrations that supported multiple healthcare workflows and real-time application features.

I also developed significant portions of the Android and React Native application, integrating diagnostic medical devices, secure report generation and exchange, native mobile capabilities, and health worker workflows that enabled seamless communication between connected devices and backend services.

Throughout the project I worked across the complete engineering lifecycle, including architecture, backend development, AI integration, mobile development, cloud deployment, debugging, production optimization, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to transform complex healthcare requirements into production-ready software.

### System Architecture & Ecosystem

![End-to-End Engineering Architecture](../assets/images/projects/liferythm/End-to-End%20Engineering%20Architecture.png)
*Figure 1: End-to-End Engineering Architecture — A high-level overview of the engineering architecture behind the Healthcare AI Automation Suite. The platform connects diagnostic devices, mobile applications, scalable backend services, and AI-powered clinical workflows into a unified teleconsultation platform. This illustration highlights the end-to-end engineering approach while intentionally abstracting proprietary implementation details and internal system architecture.*

![Product Ecosystem Overview](../assets/images/projects/liferythm/Product%20Ecosystem%20Overview.png)
*Figure 2: Product Ecosystem Overview — A high-level overview of the AI-powered healthcare platform I engineered at Liferythm Healthcare. The platform combines intelligent clinical modules including AI Receptionist, Patient Triage, Clinical Notes Assistant, Clinical Decision Support, and Follow-Up Coach with a unified patient record to support end-to-end teleconsultation workflows.*
highlights: Built AI Receptionist, Clinical Documentation, patient triage, and Follow-Up workflows using Medical LLMs
Developed FastAPI microservices and LangGraph orchestration powering production healthcare workflows
Integrated Bluetooth medical device SDKs with React Native applications for connected diagnostics
Contributed across architecture, deployment, model evaluation, and production AI workflows

title: PokeDreamer
tagline: Dreamer-style world models for model-based reinforcement learning
description: Research project exploring Dreamer-style world models for model-based reinforcement learning. Focused on learning latent environment dynamics, improving long-horizon prediction, and reducing compounding errors during imagination rollouts.
markdown:
### Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Research
Exploring latent imagination dynamics in high-dimensional visual environments.

### Technical Features
* **Recurrent State-Space Models (RSSM)**: Captures discrete transitions to predict future states with reduced drift.
* **Imagination Rollouts**: Predicts environments 15 frames into the future for latent MPC planners.
* **Mitigating Compounding Error**: Implements scheduled sampling to stabilize prediction over long horizons.
highlights: Engineered a discrete native-resolution Recurrent State-Space Model (RSSM)
Implemented a VAE+GRU dynamics baseline with continuous latent MPC planners
Executed scheduled-sampling ablation studies to evaluate predictive accuracy
Analyzed and mitigated latent imagination drift for stable RL environments

title: NavDP Sandbox
tagline: Navigation Diffusion Policy extension for omni-directional robotics
description: Academic research fork extending the official Navigation Diffusion Policy (NavDP) framework. Solves simulation-to-reality gaps through custom omni-directional hardware integration and physics optimization.
markdown:
### Sim-to-Real Navigation Diffusion Policies
Deploys diffusion policies trained in simulation environments onto physical three-wheeled LeKiwi omni-directional robots.

### Core Engineering Accomplishments
* **USD Collision Geometry fixes**: Programmatically repaired collision meshes in Nvidia Isaac Sim.
* **Actuator Dynamics Tuning**: Tuning gain schedules to resolve simulation explosions and NaN losses.
* **Multi-View Telemetry**: Built real-time rendering tools for BEV tracking and path evaluation.
highlights: Integrated a custom LeKiwi 3-wheeled omni-directional robot into the pipeline
Programmatically re-engineered and fixed broken USD collision geometries
Resolved NaN simulation explosions via actuator gain and physics tuning
Developed custom multi-perspective tools (BEV/3rd-Person) for path evaluation

title: STS Chatbot

title: Eco Chain
tagline: Full-stack Web3 marketplace for carbon credit tokenization
description: A decentralized full-stack application (DApp) structured to bring transparency and automated trading to environmental assets. Designed specifically to reduce double-counting in carbon markets.
markdown:

Deploys smart contracts to establish verified tracking ledgers for carbon offset credits.

### Core Implementation
* **Solidity Smart Contracts**: Tokenizes offsets via secure ERC-20 structures to prevent double-spending.
* **DApp Frontend**: Responsive dashboard using React, MetaMask integration, and Ethers.js.
* **Logistics Ledger**: Public tracing database connecting buyers with real-world verification sources.
highlights: Programmed Ethereum smart contracts via Solidity for secure ERC-20 tokenization
Architected a responsive MERN-stack frontend bridging traditional UI with Web3 protocols
Integrated MetaMask flows for secure, decentralized user authentication and signing
Automated decentralized funding ledgers to drastically improve market transparency

title: WakeBot32
tagline: Low-power IoT automation tool with secure remote access
description: A practical, lightweight C++ hardware application utilizing an ESP32 microcontroller. Circumvents the need for heavy local servers by acting as a dedicated, secure bridge for remote PC wake commands.
markdown:
### ESP32-Powered Hardware WOL Gateway
A secure, low-power IoT device acting as a bridge to send remote wake commands to host systems.

### Technical Design
* **C++ Arduino firmware**: Written to manage secure memory allocation and minimize power consumption.
* **Telegram Bot polling**: Polling triggers wake requests directly without opening ports on the local network router.
* **WOL Packet Generation**: Broadcasts custom WOL packets over local subnet masks.
highlights: Engineered robust, low-power ESP32 hardware memory interactions using C++
Implemented a secure, user-authenticated polling bridge utilizing the Telegram API
Constructed and deployed network-level Wake-on-LAN (WOL) magic packets
Designed an automated hardware-reboot architecture to guarantee long-term stability
